description:
[read-only] Lists content items (drafts), newest first, one page at a time: each item is a summary (id, title, type, durationMs, createdAt, postState "posted" / "scheduled" / null). Page with `limit` and `cursor` (the previous page's nextCursor). Call get_content with an id for the full item: caption, media, per-platform text and where it went out.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/content.)

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. Omitted: the key's brand (brand-bound key) or the owner's active brand.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: Top-level item fields to return instead of the summary. Default summary: id, title, type, durationMs, createdAt, postState. For one item in full, use the matching get_ tool.

name: list_content
title: List content
